title: tephroseris balbisiana
intro: Tephroseris balbisiana, commonly known as the Alpine Daisy or Mountain Everlasting, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. The plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tephroseris balbisiana include treating coughs, colds, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
